    Boundary subspaces on block quiver modules as position sets #

    The transports along letters act on position sets (ptr, ptrs), and for every half-word h the subspaces h⁺, h⁻ of a block quiver module are supported on explicit position sets (plus_eq_blk, minus_eq_blk). The pair functors are then supported on explicit sets and have dimension |num \ den| · dim V.
